title: Hunter x Hunter
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Gon Freecss leaves home to pass the Hunter Exam and find his father, a famous Hunter. With friends Killua, a runaway from an assassin family, Kurapika and Leorio, he faces deadly exams, a criminal gang, a game world and a man-eating Chimera Ant invasion.
life_message: It holds up friendship and curiosity while asking what strength and moral choice cost.

content.note: Very violent fights and gore, with deaths during the exam and the Chimera Ant arc (Wikipedia; AniList Gore, Assassins, Death Game; CSM).
Man-eating monsters and dark adult themes (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy).
Profanity (CSM on the anime; manga level to verify).
Killua's controlled childhood and Gon's dark turn (to verify).

delivery.note: The cost of strength is explored through Gon's choices, and the story extends sympathy even to some monsters and criminals.

winners_losers: Friendship survives while power-seekers on all sides pay a price; the series gives sympathy even to some monsters and criminals.
